prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website direction comp, 16:10 landscape
Primary request: Design the first viewport and a glimpse of the next section for PIMP AUTO, a multilingual concierge service that locates rare and hard-to-find car parts by VIN, part number, or photo. This must read as a shippable website interface, not a poster and not concept art.
Structure: compact top rail with PIMP AUTO at left and language switch RU EN FR PL at right; two-column opening where the left 42% holds the main promise, a short supporting sentence, and one strong request action; the right 58% is a dominant exploded mechanical assembly arranged across four overlapping translucent technical sheets; a narrow lower band shows the real flow ЗАПРОС → ПОИСК → СОВМЕСТИМОСТЬ → ДОСТАВКА and small regional shop tabs. Show enough below the fold to prove the system continues.
Subject content: premium and classic automotive parts sourcing, technical compatibility, international regions, physical point in Mandelieu. The mechanical object should clearly be an elegant classic-car component, such as a carburetor or headlamp assembly, rendered as a precise exploded parts illustration on layered drafting films.
Visual world: archival parts catalogue rebuilt from translucent vellum overlays, registration marks, crop ticks, tiny OEM-style annotations, matte metal hardware. Depth only through real sheet overlap, never through glassmorphism. Cobalt blue owns roughly 40% of the surface, with warm silver grey, near-black ink, and safety orange reserved only for the primary action.
Typography: authoritative narrow grotesk display, large but no more than five words per line; quiet highly legible grotesk body; no serif, no monospaced costume, no tiny illegible text.
Text (verbatim): "PIMP AUTO"; "Найдём редкую деталь для вашего автомобиля"; "По VIN, номеру или фотографии — с доставкой в ваш регион."; "ОТПРАВИТЬ ЗАПРОС"; "С 2011"; "ЗАПРОС"; "ПОИСК"; "СОВМЕСТИМОСТЬ"; "ДОСТАВКА"; "RU  EN  FR  PL".
Interaction cues: one orange rectangular action, square technical tabs, visible focus-ready controls; no rounded card grid.
Constraints: premium, precise, original; practical navigation and reading order; no invented prices, testimonials, response-time claims, logos of car manufacturers, or exact address; no gradients, no glass panels, no pill buttons, no generic dashboard cards, no watermark.
